headline: iPhone Duo's battery capacity revealed in EU regulatory filing
summary: Apple has officially disclosed the iPhone Duo's battery capacity via an EU regulatory document. This reveal provides concrete data for comparison with other iPhone models and competitor devices.
details: Apple has officially disclosed the iPhone Duo's battery capacity through an EU regulatory document. This information became available shortly after pre-orders for the new device opened.

Historically, Apple typically refrains from publishing the exact milliamp-hour (mAh) specifications for its iPhone batteries. Instead, the company usually provides estimates based on usage metrics like "hours of video playback."

The release of this regulatory filing offers a rare, precise look at the iPhone Duo's power source. This data allows consumers and tech analysts to directly compare its battery size against previous iPhone generations and competing smartphones.
